clusters.description: Clusters of related categories organized around the core category.

cluster_label.description: Theoretical label for the cluster. Expresses the cluster's role relative to the core category.

theoretical_family.description: The theoretical code family that best describes this cluster's organizing logic (e.g., Strategy, Causal, Process, Condition).

description.description: Narrative description of what unifies these categories theoretically. 2-4 sentences.

is_core_member.description: true if this category is a core member of the cluster (strong hypothesis connections).

relationship_to_core.description: How this category relates to the core category per documented hypotheses: is_a_strategy_for, is_a_condition_of, co-occurs_with.

is_cohesive.description: true if the categories in this cluster are tightly connected via documented hypotheses.

cohesion_rationale.description: Why this cluster is or is not cohesive. Reference specific hypothesis connections.

is_priority.description: true if this cluster should be prioritized in the saturation loop (directly relates to core concern).

priority_rationale.description: Why this cluster was assigned this priority.

unclustered_categories.description: Categories with no documented hypothesis relationship to any other category.

suggested_action.description: Recommendation: search for relationships, mark as secondary, or discard.

bridging_categories.description: Categories that connect two or more clusters.

bridging_rationale.description: How this category bridges the clusters.

sorting_recommendation.description: Overall recommendation: which clusters to elaborate first, which gaps to address, whether the hypothesis graph is mature enough for theoretical coding.
